title: "Blessed" by the Muses
subtitle: A craftsman's clattering inspiration does not end with the dark.

items.text: Inside the Temple
Flickering lights dance over the temple's reliefs. Below them, figures dart between the Maenads and Satyrs.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: These the weird things you were talking about, Kassandra?
She lowers her voice, talking as if she were an old friend.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Cor, look at these! Ladies dancing, beastie boys grooving to the music, and who's the bloke with the naff hat ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: If I didn't know any better, I'd have guessed he was some kind of Greek god of rock'n'roll!

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: *cough*

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Are we sure we haven't messed around with time and space here?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is a temple to Dionysos, who was, among other things, a god of joy, passion, and chaos. It's little wonder his reliefs would reflect that.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Right then, so he IS a proper rock god, just thousands of years early. Give or take ...
Her enthusiasm hits Kassandra like a wave against a steady ship.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: ... I'm not sure I understood anything you just said.
Before she can continue, a ribbon swaying in the breeze catches her attention.
She grasps the ribbon in a swift motion and slices it through.
Worm-like patterns coil and twist along the ribbon.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hey, don't look at us, mate! We didn't do it!

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Of course you didn't; we only just got here.
The marks on it leave a fresh ink stain on her finger.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Not that I'm above a bit of vandalism, but what's your angle?

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Quiet.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: These ribbons are not decorations.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: They are desecrations.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: These symbols are similar to the ones on Perikles's bounty.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: That cannot be a coincidence.
Regulus stares in silent disbelief as she reads the value of the bounty. Though, being Regulus, her silence doesn't last.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Bounties and puzzles could wait!—Mr. APPLe can't! First priority is rescuing him from this spooky place.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Who knows what they've done to him!

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: We'll look for your friend soon. First, I need to scout out the surroundings; I'm not sure it is safe here.
She crouches low to the ground, running her fingers along the marble floor.
A faint trail of footsteps guides them toward the inner sanctum of the temple.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: We aren't the first visitors here tonight.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's difficult to say how many have come through; the prints are too jumbled.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: No one is supposed to be here after the tributes have been laid in the inner temple. Not until the statue returns after the Dionysia.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: That means whoever's up ahead is up to no good, right?

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: It's possible.
She eases her steps into a silent crawl.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Stay behind me.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No need to worry about us, love. We can handle ourselves.

items.speaker: "Craftsman" I
items.text: Be careful, Timon! Don't break those pots! What if the Eagle Bearer noticed! She's as sharp-eyed as her eagle!

items.speaker: "Craftsman" I
items.text: How stupid can you get, Aristion?! Is this the first time you've used a reed pen?! That charcoal powder isn't cheap!

items.speaker: "Craftsman" I
items.text: We're doomed if we upset Deimos!

items.speaker: "Craftsman" II
items.text: I don't mean to interrupt, Lysias, but ... all that shouting isn't doing any good.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Agreed.
Faster than the west wind, she brings her spear up to the craftsman's throat.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Maybe my ears deceive me, but you don't sound much like craftsmen.

items.speaker: "Craftsman" II
items.text: E-Eagle Bearer?!

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Nor killers for that matter. Not professional ones, anyway.
Her words sound colder than the edge of her spear. The hostage can't help but shiver.

items.speaker: "Craftsman" II
items.text: W-We are craftsmen! We're here to repaint the temple for the Dionysia—

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Save your lies. What you are doing here has nothing to do with the Dionysia.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Now, who is your master? Speak!

items.speaker: "Craftsman" II
items.text: You, you—
He grips his file aggressively; before either can react, a gnashing order is barked from within the darkness.

items.speaker: "Craftsman" I
items.text: Malaka, kill her!
The battle is over swiftly.
The Spear of Leonidas easily tears their disguises away, revealing familiar black cuirasses and gloves.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: I know this armor. You are from the Cult of Kosmos.

items.speaker: "Craftsman" I
items.text: You're making dangerous enemies, Eagle Bearer.
He dons a hideous mask.

items.speaker: "Cultist I"
items.text: None dare oppose us ...

items.speaker: "Cultist I"
items.text: ... who value their lives!
He reveals a hidden axe and brings it down toward her.
Hold.
A cold voice rings out of the darkness.
Leave her to me.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: That voice ... I should have guessed, Alexios.

items.speaker: Alexios
items.text: "The mercenary with the broken spear," do you still wear that title, sister?

items.speaker: "Cultist I"
items.text: Deimos, forgive us, we've failed ...

items.speaker: Alexios
items.text: Get out of my sight, all of you!

items.speaker: "Cultist I"
items.text: Y-yes ...

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: You surprise me, Alexios. I didn't think you'd stoop so low.

items.speaker: Alexios
items.text: I told you to stay out of my way, Kassandra.

items.speaker: Alexios
items.text: Yet here you are.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: The cult has deceived you. You don't know what it means to kill Perikles.

items.speaker: Alexios
items.text: I know that he has defied us!

items.speaker: Alexios
items.text: And that whoever stands in the way of our plans must pay the price.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: You can't bring peace through destruction, Alexios.

items.speaker: Alexios
items.text: You cling to your loyalties so blindly.
He walks down from the platform, retaking his sword while observing his surroundings.
Colorful banners have been draped from the ceiling down to the ground. Pots and flagons litter the temple floor. It appears the cultists left in a hurry.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: I won't let you kill him, not while I still draw breath.
She squares up to him and readies her spear.
They stand at odds; each ready to strike. But the expected attack never arrives, as Alexios breathes out a long-held breath.

items.speaker: Alexios
items.text: This is the last time I spare your life.
A smoke bomb explodes between them. Kassandra catches a final venomous look on Alexios's face before he disappears.
Her brother's strange and sudden mercy weighs on her mind only a moment before a distant shout refocuses her attention.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Help! Kassandra!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain ... Vertin ... I'm here ...
The fruit, now fully immersed in honey, manages to sputter out a plea for help.
The thick sweetness drips all over his shallow basket, which has attracted a few birds that flit about it looking for a snack.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: I know exactly who to call.
The Eagle Bearer looks up at the sky and raises her arm. Within half a heartbeat, they hear a piercing cry echo between the temple's pillars.

items.speaker: Ikaros
items.text: Scree!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Mr. Eagle, please mind those claws; I have delicate skin!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Oh ... my thanks.
The sweetened fruit is pulled into a warm hug.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Good to see you again, First Mate! I was starting to worry I'd have to read your obituary out on Radio APPLe!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The rumors of my death may have been exaggerated, Captain.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I should feel quite put out if I couldn't join the 27 club with you.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Too right you should! You aren't allowed to die without my permission!
As Regulus returns to the ground with her partially embalmed first mate, she gives Kassandra a hearty tap on the shoulder.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So, what should I name your thank-you performance? I've got some fab ideas already—

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The Heroine and the Screech of Night, Whispers on the Edge of the Temple: Love and Courage Dancing in the Moonlight; or The Dark Night of Freedom, The Stars and the Eagle Bearer Guide Us ...

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: A show? You're naming a drama after me?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Don't mind her. Thank you for the help, Kassandra.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Don't sell yourselves short. You've already done a great deal to help me.
She pats down her sleeves, trying not to give too much weight to her actions.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Nonetheless, we'd like to do more than just help you with spotting clues.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In fact, if you don't mind, we'd like to join your investigation to repay your kindness.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Too right! Mr. APPLe is always going on about all this Greek stuff! With that great honking big brain of his, we're sure to be of help!

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Even though you are all very, very strange ...

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: I do think we work well together.
Several hands are placed together in a moment of sincere warmth.
